Offer to Declare War: When checked, gives you the option to declare war when moving into a tile containing a rival unit. Always gives the option when moving into rival territory without open borders.
Sentry While Healing
When checked, units ordered to heal will awaken when they spot danger, acting like sentries.
Only Neutral Territory

When checked, if Sentry While Healing is enabled, units will awaken to danger only when in neutral territory. This stops your attacking force from waking up each turn outside an enemy city or your defenders inside friendly territory.
Ignore Harmless Barbarians
When checked, barbarian units adjacent to your borders will not trigger a warning if they cannot enter.
PreChop Forests
When checked, Workers ordered to chop a forest will stop with 1 turn remaining. Issue the order again to finish the chop.
PreChop Improvements
When checked, Workers ordered to build an improvement that will remove a forest will stop with 1 turn remaining. Issue the order again to finish the improvement.
Airport Icons
When checked, places an airport icon above the city bars of cities that have an airport.
Turns to Starvation
When checked, shows how many turns until a city will lose population if it is shrinking.
Health
When checked, shows the net health ([ICON_HEALTHY] or [ICON_UNHEALTHY]) for the city.
Happiness
When checked, shows the net happiness ([ICON_HAPPY] or [ICON_UNHAPPY]) for the city.
Hurry Anger
When checked, shows the number of angry population ([ICON_ANGRYPOP]) due to whipping and the number of turns left on the timer.
Draft Anger
When checked, shows the number of angry population ([ICON_ANGRYPOP]) due to drafting and the number of turns left on the timer.
Growth Detail
When checked, shows more detailed information about growth (growing, shrinking, starvation, stagnation).
Base Values
When checked, holding CTRL while hovering shows the base (without modifiers) values for most items: production, trade, commerce, maintenance, great people.
Base Production
When checked, shows base production (excludes overflow, whipping, and chopping) in addition to the current turn's production.
Building Actual Effects
When checked and a city is constructing a building, the actual yield of [ICON_COMMERCE], [ICON_HAPPY], [ICON_HEALTHY], and [ICON_GREATPEOPLE] it will produce are displayed.
City Bar
When checked, shows the cost ([ICON_CITIZEN] or [ICON_GOLD]) and overflow ([ICON_PRODUCTION] and [ICON_GOLD]) for hurrying (whip and/or buy) the item being produced.
Include Current
When checked, includes the current turn's production when calculating overflow ([ICON_PRODUCTION] and/or [ICON_GOLD]) from hurrying with the whip.
Trade
When checked, shows breakdowns for trade: total, foreign, and foreign overseas. Each includes those after it: foreign includes foreign overseas, and total includes both foreign and foreign overseas.
Commerce
When checked, the total commerce ([ICON_COMMERCE]) is shown before the individual commerce types ([ICON_GOLD], [ICON_RESEARCH], [ICON_CULTURE], and [ICON_ESPIONAGE]).
Building Icons
When checked, the list of buildings is shown using icons instead of their names.
Culture Turns
When checked, shows the number of turns until the city's borders expand due to culture ([ICON_CULTURE]).
Great Person Turns
When checked, shows the number of turns until the city will create the next great person ([ICON_GREATPEOPLE]).
Specialists
When checked, shows icons for the city's specialists (both citizens and settled great people).
Revolt Chance
When checked, shows the probability that the city will revolt due to cultural pressure.
Hide Instructions
When checked, hides the instructions for selecting cities and showing base values to make room for the new information.
Highlight Workable Area
When checked, highlights the area of tiles controlled by the selected city, similar to when you select a Settler.
Highlight Tile Improvability
When checked, highlights each tile controlled by the selected city using a color based on whether it's being worked and your ability to improve it.
Improved
When checked, highlights tiles being worked that have already been improved.
Improvable
When checked, highlights tiles being worked that can be improved.
Improvable w. Bonus
When checked, highlights tiles being worked that can be improved to provide a bonus.
Unimprovable
When checked, highlights tiles being worked that cannot be improved.
Improved
When checked, highlights tiles not being worked that have already been improved.
Improvable
When checked, highlights tiles not being worked that can be improved.
Improvable w. Bonus
When checked, highlights tiles not being worked that can be improved to provide a bonus.
Unimprovable
When checked, highlights tiles not being worked that cannot be improved.
Hidden Attitude
When checked, displays the hidden attitude modifiers (possibly spoiler).
Worst Enemy
When checked, the worst enemy of each AI rival is shown in the hover text for their icon.
Defensive Pacts
When checked, the defensive pacts of each rival are shown in the hover text for their icon.
Longitude / Latitude
When checked, the longitude and latitude are shown when hovering over a plot once you have centered the map.
Working City
When checked, hovering over a tile your team owns shows which city controls it, in cyan if it is being worked.
Recommended Build
When checked, hovering over a tile you own shows the improvement or route an automated worker would build.
Partial Builds

When checked, hovering over a tile that has partially-completed builds (improvements, routes, and chops) will show how many worker turns are required to complete them as long as your workers can actually do so.
Upgrade Name
When checked, if a unit's name contains its type (e.g. "Swordsman 5 of London"), it is replaced by the new type when upgrading (e.g. "Maceman 5 of London").
Starting Experience
When checked, displays the experience points and number of available promotions a new unit will receive in the Train Unit button hover.
Starting Experience Modifiers
When checked, displays the experience point modifiers (buildings, military instructors, civics, and wonders) in the Train Unit button hover.
Building

When checked, the actual yield of [ICON_COMMERCE], [ICON_HAPPY], [ICON_HEALTHY], [ICON_GREATPEOPLE], and [ICON_DEFENSE] the building will produce for the city are displayed in the building hover text.
Speeds Up ...
When checked, displays the technologies that will be sped up by acquiring the technology you are hovering over (e.g. Animal Husbandry would be shown for Agriculture once you have acquired Hunting).
Technology Trade Denial
When checked, hovering over a technology in the "Won't Trade" column of the Foreign Advisor's TECHS page will show you the AI's reason for denying the trade.
Resource Trade Denial
When checked, hovering over a resource in the "Won't Trade" column of the Foreign Advisor's RESOURCES page will show you the AI's reason for denying the trade.
Commerce Subtotals
When checked, the subtotal (total before modifiers) is shown when necessary for each commerce type in its hover.
Rate Breakdown
When checked, displays the individual [ICON_GREATPEOPLE] rate per turn for each type in the hover.
Maintenance
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect maintenance costs ([ICON_GOLD]) and by how much.
Food
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect the [ICON_FOOD] rate and by how much.
Production
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect the [ICON_PRODUCTION] rate and by how much.
Commerce
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect the [ICON_COMMERCE], [ICON_GOLD], [ICON_RESEARCH], [ICON_CULTURE], and [ICON_ESPIONAGE] rates and by how much.
Health
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect the [ICON_HEALTHY] and [ICON_UNHEALTHY] rates and by how much.
Happiness
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect the [ICON_HAPPY] and [ICON_UNHAPPY] rates and by how much.
Great People
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect the [ICON_GREATPEOPLE] rate and by how much.
City Defense
When checked, displays the buildings that will affect the [ICON_DEFENSE] of the city and from bombardment and by how much.
Draft Unit Details
When checked, displays the full details of the unit that will be drafted in the Draft button hover.
Draft Limit
When checked, displays the number of units you can draft this turn and whether the city has already drafted in the Draft button hover.
Whip Button
When checked, the Whip Button hover includes the overflow ([ICON_PRODUCTION] and [ICON_GOLD]) created by applying the whip.
Include Current
When checked, the whip overflow calculation includes the current [ICON_PRODUCTION] rate. Since applying the whip usually affects the rate, the actual overflow may be different.
Remove Specialist Button
When checked, the hover text for the Remove Specialist button includes the same specialist information shown on the Add Specialist button.
Zoom to City Details
When checked, the Zoom to City button includes detailed information about the city as when hovering over a city bar on the map.
Health Effects from Features
When checked, the hover text for any Worker action that will remove a feature with health effects (e.g. Forest or Jungle) will list the effect on each nearby city.
Consider Other Workers
When checked, the effect of removing a feature on each nearby city will take into account Workers performing actions that will remove a feature from other tiles.
